opportunities.name: United flight search by route and dates
opportunities.description: On united.com, search flights from {origin} to {destination} for {depart_date} (and {return_date}), with optional passenger/cabin/miles settings, then click Find flights and optionally pick a fare.
steps: Open the BOOK tab (pick 'Book with miles' if needed)
Type {origin} in the departing city box and choose the matching airport
Type {destination} in the destination box and choose the matching airport
Open the Depart date picker, move to the right month, and click {depart_date} and {return_date}
Change travelers/cabin if needed (e.g., remove the extra adult, choose Premium economy)
Click Find flights
Optionally pick a fare from the results

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search parking near {venue}, choose {event} (optionally on {date}), apply filters like wheelchair access, sort, set start/end times, and update the search or book.
steps: Type {venue} in 'Search for parking' and pick the suggestion
Optionally open 'Select Event Date' and choose {date}
Click the {event}
Optionally click Filter, tick 'Wheelchair Accessible', and click Show Results
Choose the {sort} order
Set Start Time and End Time if needed, then click Update Search
Optionally click Book Now

opportunities.name: TripAdvisor restaurant search with filter
opportunities.description: On TripAdvisor, open Restaurants, search for {location}, pick it, and apply a {cuisine/feature} filter.
steps: Click Restaurants
Type {location} in the search box and pick the matching result
Optionally open 'More restaurants' / 'Show more' in the filters
Tick the {filter} label (cuisine or feature) and click Apply
Optionally narrow to the location or open 'Order online'

opportunities.name: United map search from an origin city
opportunities.description: On United's map search, enter {origin} in 'Flying from', set the trip options, and run the search to see destinations.
steps: Open Map search
Type {origin} in 'Flying from' and pick the airport
Optionally set Search type (e.g., Roundtrip) and Flexible dates
Click Search and look at the results/date range
